description: Election Commission - Mrs. S. J. Dayananda of the Kandy Municipal Council has Vacated her Office of member of that Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Kandy Municipal Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and related matters specifically covered by Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), as it involves the status of an elected official in a local authority under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
